title: AI-Enabled Standards-Aligned Security Risk Management
description: Reproducible software artifact for leakage-safe IoT telemetry evaluation, standards traceability, auditable security risk scoring, and cost-aware control portfolio optimization aligned with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and NIST CSF 2.0. The current main branch contains the validated Science of Computer Programming R1 software candidate; manuscript materials remain local until publication.
